fields.statement: Built rhiza from the branch head; ran `rhiza guide <topic>` for every topic in `rhiza guide ls`: no `<!-- shared:` marker survives and the builder/verifier/build-retry texts show the shared done, test-scope, unstable-CI, command-budget, outside-work and never-list blocks expanded in place; `rhiza guide nosuch` exits 4. go test -trimpath ./internal/guide/... ok.

Built rhiza; `rhiza guide builder` prints Task, Expected outcome, Read first, Must do, Must not do, Context as its only ## sections (shared blocks nested as ###), with the acceptance contract, read-pattern-first, question-before-work, Checks: block above one final trailer paragraph, the actor-record git add line and the RHIZA_ATTEMPT > 1 route to /rhiza-build-retry; the commands it names (slice, show, ship generate, render, session done, change new/use, link) all exist in the built binary.

Built rhiza; `rhiza guide build-retry` (192 tokens) says inspect the working tree and earlier commits, read findings from the prompt or `rhiza run status --json`, address every finding as written, one fix commit with the same Leaf: trailer, never rewrite history; it repeats none of the builder's shared blocks.

Built rhiza; `rhiza guide ls` lists build, builder, verifier and build-retry; `rhiza guide build` is a short index naming /rhiza-builder, /rhiza-verifier, /rhiza-build-retry and their `rhiza guide` routes; `HOME=<scratch> rhiza guide install --agent claude` wrote 10 files incl. skills/rhiza-builder, rhiza-verifier, rhiza-build-retry and rhiza-build SKILL.md with the topic descriptions and expanded bodies (verifier body matches `rhiza guide verifier`), and a second install reported 0 written, 10 unchanged. go test ./internal/api -run GuideInstall and TestScripts/(guide|guide-install|build-evidence-commit) ok.

Built rhiza; `rhiza workflow describe build` and `docs-build` show the one-line /rhiza-builder and /rhiza-verifier prompts, docs-build keeping the humanize addendum after the builder line; review.toml and docs-review.toml verifier prompts are byte-identical to build.toml's; `rhiza workflow check` reports build, review, docs-build, docs-review valid; go test ./internal/workflow/... and TestScripts/(build-evidence-commit|docs-commands-exist|describe-golden) ok; make self-check passes from a clean detached checkout.
